activity: Read source, current diff, contract, and test assertions only. No tests, browser actions, user-save operations, source edits, or Git mutations performed.
excluded: App inspection ownership repair is owned by parent; this report does not re-audit its concurrent changes.

findings.status: requires verification and repair or explicit contract clarification
findings.problem: The cached SourcePlanner reinitializes cycles, target fields, and monthBudget after a real location change, but leaves reserve from the previous location. The contract states actual location or life changes rebuild the context.
findings.reproduction: At wilderness set a source draft remaining-month reserve to 9, close settings, actually travel to a different location that has sources, reopen sources and arrangement. The new source count and month budget reset while reserve remains 9. Travel through an empty-source location and return has the same residue.
findings.minimalFix: Reset the complete source draft only on real runId/location change, including reserve; preserve same-object, category-only, normal tick, and pause drafts. If reserve is intentionally global policy, state that explicitly and verify it rather than asserting all parameters reset.
findings.evidence: SourcePlanner select initializes multiple fields but never reserve; the new KeepAlive preserves this component within one run.

findings.problem: Re-selecting the already selected encounter enemy unconditionally calls defaultEncounterPlan and discards edited finite limits and strategy, contrary to the general same-object draft rule in AGENTS R2.
findings.reproduction: Select wolf, set 2 encounters/82 actions/2 months and a nondefault medicine strategy, return to object tab, then click the already selected wolf. Limits and strategy revert to defaults without a new target.
findings.minimalFix: Treat same enemy selection as a no-op for the draft; keep actual enemy change initialization and initial unavailable-enemy fallback. Do not suppress explicit saved-plan restoration.
findings.evidence: AdventurePlanner select lacks the same-object guard added to SourcePlanner; current R2 tests cover this only for source objects.

preservedByInspectedDiff: SourcePlan data fields still include maxCycles/until/target/monthBudget/remainingMonthsReserve. Default cycle/month values and one-cycle preview use the same formal functions.

Encounter form fields were moved from object details to limits, not deleted: count, target, target quantity, maxCycles, monthBudget, remainingMonthsReserve, mpBudget remain. Finite summary remains visible on the object page.

Battle strategy priorities, heavy-response, release threshold, both medicine thresholds/budgets/reserves, and danger/risk controls remain in BattleStrategy. Manual seven actions remain mapped to the original events.
Source current-working presentation checks activity version/source/run/Game revision plus runtime id/generation and does not add a clock or reward mutation.
New CSS is imported through main.ts and targets existing stage/component class bindings. KeepAlive emits no wrapper element that would invalidate direct-child CSS layout selectors.
Native dialog closes on SourcePlanner deactivation; category inspection keeps the draft without starting or committing Game.
